title: Cohomological boundedness for the canonical Brown right adjoint
statement: Fix the standing ell-adic coefficient, schemes, and proper morphism of lem-sfb-adic-localizing-exceptional-bounded. If the proper localizing pushforward F = ellAdicLocalizingLowerStar has its canonical Brown right adjoint supplied by an IsLeftAdjoint witness, then for every bounded constructible K the underlying object of the canonical right adjoint F.rightAdjoint(K) has homology vanishing outside a finite integer interval.

proof.text: Use the coefficient comparison and the rational and integral restriction theorems on finite affine charts to show that the geometric exceptional inverse image of K has homology in a finite interval; the finite affine cover gives common bounds. Identify this geometric functor with the canonical Brown right adjoint by the proper comparison and the canonical adjunction.
